description: Convert the raw inventory text list in '/home/ga/Documents/raw_inventory_dump.docx' into a professional price list table. The document contains tab-separated product data. You must: (1) Select the text and convert it to a table (Table > Convert > Text to Table), (2) Ensure the first row (headers) is bold or formatted as a heading, (3) Sort the table by the 'Price' column in Descending order (highest price at the top) using Table > Sort (ensure the header row is excluded from sorting), and (4) Save the result as a new file at '/home/ga/Documents/formatted_price_list.docx'. Do not overwrite the original file.
